messages:
maya: Quick update — we're rolling out a small but important change to route-level latency budgets and running a quiet-window failover dry-run this Saturday.

maya: TL;DR: p95 target for /v1/generate routes moves from 120ms -> 100ms for hosted-tier, grace window 2w. Dry-run failover: Sat 2026-04-11 02:00-03:30 UTC in west-1 -> east-1 fallback, no customer traffic will be cut, it's simulated using canary traffic and service proxies.

ajay: Why reduce budget? any perf risk for customers?

maya: It's to match model/infra improvements (runtime kernel updates + batching improvements). We still hold p99 SLOs. This is a policy alignment — teams can opt-out for 2w per route if they need more time.

leo: Ops note: We'll run the failover as a simulated routing shift via the control plane (no az drains). Full checklist in runbook: https://infradocs/redwood/runbooks/latency-budget-2026

kira: Is there a rollback trigger list?

maya: Yes — runbook section "Rollback & Abort" lists triggers:
- error rate spike > 0.5% for 5m
- per-route p99 increased by >30% vs baseline
- client-reported degradations (Pager alert)

maya: Commands we'll use (control-plane dry-run):
```
# simulate routing shift
rcpctl route simulate-shift --route /v1/generate --from west-1 --to east-1 --ratio 100 --dry-run
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run at 2026-04-11T02:00:00Z by maya. Auto-notify: #customer-support, #product-alerts

olivia: I'll sit on comms. Adding canary prompts and eval set to catch quality regressions.

ajay: Do we need extra kvcache warmup before the test?

leo: We'll pre-warm top prefixes 30m before with this script:
```
./tools/prefill_kvcache --route /v1/generate --prefix-file top_prefixes.txt --concurrency 10
```

sre-bot: Reminder: set SLO tier to 'experimental' for affected routes during the 2w grace window if owner requests. Use /slo update CLI.

maya: Action items:
- eng-sre: execute dry-run Saturday 02:00 UTC (leo)
- infra-ml: confirm kernel canary is stable (ajay)
- prod-eng: opt-out requests to ops@redwood.com by EOD Thu
- comms: olivia

kira: acked. I'll monitor dashboards and keep a Slack bridge open.

maya: Thanks — we'll post a short incident-style summary after the dry-run. Ping me if you want to opt-out or need clarifications. :rocket:
